user_saw: Nothing visible; the app kept one destroyed Activity in memory until the next Activity attached.
summary: CameraCaptureManager now observes the attached lifecycle owner, clears it on ON_DESTROY if it is still current, removes the old observer on replacement, and ignores owners that are already destroyed.
reasoning: Issue #195636 came from static review: it describes a retained reference and a hypothetical bind against a destroyed owner, and the only device evidence is a trace showing the reference held until a replacement attaches. Captures already require foreground admission, which implies a live replacement Activity, so no failed capture was reported. The plain `lifecycleOwner = owner` store is long-standing (GraphQL blame goes back past the graft to January 2026 renames) and was never changed by a breaking commit, so this is lifecycle hardening of a bounded single-object leak rather than a reported defect.
